metadata.title: Claiming your Unclaimed Funds
metadata.author: ohiocommerce
metadata.shortDescription:
#OhioUnclaimedFunds #UnclaimedFunds #DivisionUnclaimedFunds

This video is a replay of a live webinar recorded on February 28, 2024 hosted by the Better Business Bureau of Central Ohio where we covered everything on claiming your unclaimed funds.
Unclaimed Funds is lost or forgotten money from inactive accounts that is reported by banks and businesses to the State of Ohio Division of Unclaimed Funds for safekeeping. The money come from inactive checking accounts, savings accounts, refund/credit balances, uncashed cashier’s checks, life insurance benefits, stocks & bonds, and safe deposit box contents. After attending this webinar, you will learn: What are unclaimed funds, how to find out if you have any, and the steps to claiming funds, Claiming on behalf of a deceased family member and the required documentation,  Claims timeline and delays, Claims status, and Claims resources. Visit unclaimedfunds.ohio.gov to search your name and claim your money today!
